description: Defines constants, string conversions, and utility functions related to cookies, including cookie priorities, SameSite attributes, port ranges, and URL schemes.

methods.name: CookiePriorityToString
methods.description: Converts a CookiePriority enum to its string representation.

methods.name: StringToCookiePriority
methods.description: Converts a string to a CookiePriority enum.

methods.name: CookieSameSiteToString
methods.description: Converts a CookieSameSite enum to its string representation.

methods.name: StringToCookieSameSite
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the CookieSameSite enum and sets the samesite_string accordingly.

methods.name: RecordCookieSameSiteAttributeValueHistogram
methods.description: Records a histogram value for the Cookie SameSite attribute.

methods.name: ReducePortRangeForCookieHistogram
methods.description: Maps a port number to a port category for histogram purposes.

methods.name: GetSchemeNameEnum
methods.description: Determines the scheme name enum for a given URL.
